community.reason: Level 2: specific current external education and community investment (employee-led skills programs with partner organizations, donation matching) plus employee development, but no participants or dollars are disclosed to show substantial reach.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: Employee Resource Groups exist but no membership or other figures are disclosed; 'promoting diversity and inclusion' is general language and global operations across 95+ countries do not count.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: small and mid-sized businesses are among the customers, but there is no specific enabling service, and the company focuses on larger enterprises.

notes: Marketing 'customer education', webinars and training programs are treated as educating customers as marketing (trap), not external education. Code of conduct trainings are compliance training and are not counted. 'Foundation' refers to platform architecture. The Item 7 excerpts mention education only as a customer industry and as a sales and marketing expense line. Self-hosted and on-premises products have an announced end-of-life of December 31, 2026, which is not relevant to the themes. Community programs are described as employee-led volunteering with no reach figures, so they stay at level 2.
